    QUESTIONS

    Good questions.

    Everything you might want to know before you drop a file.

    Is IndiaDigital really free?

    Yes. Every tool is free to use, with no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limit.

    Are my files uploaded to a server?

    No. Files are processed by your own browser on your device and are never uploaded. You can check this yourself in your browser’s developer tools: processing makes no file uploads.

    How do I compress a PDF to 100 KB or 200 KB for a form?

    Open Compress PDF to 100 KB (or another size), drop your PDF and download. Picture compression keeps text sharp; pages are only rebuilt as images if that is the only way to meet the limit.

    Can I convert Word, Excel and PowerPoint to PDF without Microsoft Office?

    Yes. The converters render your document in the browser and keep headings, tables, pictures and colours, producing a PDF with selectable text.

    Does it work on my phone?

    Yes. IndiaDigital works in modern browsers on Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac and Linux. Very large files are faster on a computer.
